functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Only two-joint muscle of the adductor group; long thin strap shape and long fascicles suit its dual hip-adduction/knee-flexion role. Frequently harvested as a tendon graft (e.g. ACL reconstruction) given its functional redundancy with the other adductors and hamstrings.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
